svg.title: Malta Lotto Quaterno: what a 3-euro ticket is worth

g.text: 買了一張 3 歐元的馬耳他 Quaterno 樂透。
I spent €3 on a Malta Quaterno lottery ticket.
開獎會從 1 到 90 中抽出 5 個號碼。
The lottery draws 5 numbers from 1 to 90.
這是 2026 年 9 月 19 日的實際開獎結果。
Here is the actual draw from 19 Sept 2026.
開獎結果全沒中！但數學期望值是多少？
None of my numbers matched! But what is the expected value?
首先，總共有多少種 4 個號碼的組合？
First, how many total 4-number tickets are possible?
超過 250 萬種可能的彩券組合。
5 顆開獎球中，能產生幾組頭獎組合？
From the 5 drawn numbers, how many jackpot combinations exist?
中頭獎的機率是 255 萬分之 5。
The probability is 5 out of 2.5 million.
我們可以用超幾何分佈算出所有中獎機率。
We can use the hypergeometric distribution to find all probabilities.
以下是所有中獎級距與獎金。
Here are the possible winning tiers.
贏得任何獎金的總機率大約只有 1.43%。
The probability of winning any prize is only about 1.43%.
數學期望值是將所有機率乘上獎金後加總。
Expected value is the sum of probability times the prize.
每個級距都會貢獻一點期望值。
Each tier contributes to the mathematical value of your ticket.
理論上的平均回報約為 1.49 歐元。
但我們必須扣除 3 歐元的購票成本。
But we must subtract the €3 ticket cost.
淨期望值為負數，回報率大約是 49.6%。
The net expected return is negative.
中獎靠運氣，但期望值是數學。
Winning is random. Expected value is mathematics.
「我花了 3 歐元買樂透，結果數學告訴我，我的期望值是負的。🤣」
I spent €3 on a lotto ticket, and math told me my expected value is negative. 🤣
I spent €3 on Malta Lotto. What does mathematics say?
Probability does not predict the next draw.
